# Fixture provenance

Change `kit-api-sync`, design D2. Each response fixture is `{ "status", "headers", "body" }` with lowercase header names (only the headers the client reads); a `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header is kept raw (base64) and decoded under `paymentRequired`. No credit token, seed or key is stored: `<credit-token>` and `<payment-response>` are placeholders that test support code replaces at run time.

Recorded fixtures: unpaid, read-only requests to `https://api.criptonlabs.com` on 2026-11-12 (about 18:14 UTC), `network: mainnet production`, API 0.21.0 (main `ce704b9`), without any payment header, credential or SIWX proof. Bodies are the parsed production JSON, pretty-printed; the kept header values are verbatim (the challenges' SIWX nonces and timestamps are those of the recording).

Spec-derived fixtures: built from the API main spec `prepaid-credits` at `ce704b9` (`openspec/specs/prepaid-credits/spec.md`) because they need a real payment or a signed proof; values reuse the recorded fixtures (origin, bundle ids, amounts, networks, challenge).
